name: HOC Drive to Client Bot
triggers: Google Drive OAuth triggers disabled to stop resending every file in HOC Clients
Webhook GET+POST /webhook/hoc-drive-file remains for a manual kick
action: POST https://api.hoc.agency/api/integrations/drive/poll with X-N8N-Secret (no $env). Nested request-folder uploads send via Laravel Google changes.watch. Files sitting on the HOC Clients root are ignored. Already-sent files are not resent unless the file actually changed.
laravel: ops:poll-drive sends a file once; same Drive modified second is not a revision. Root folders are skipped.
